name: Felfire Adept increases Sargeron Smite's critical strike chance (#1240)
contract: Felfire Adept increases Sargeron Smite's (802060) critical strike chance by 10% (rank 1, 560836) or 20% (rank 2, 561345), via a native SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE (op7) flat SpellMod matching Sargeron Smite's family20 classMask2 bit11 flag. The DBC stores EffectBasePoints 9/19 with DieSides 1, so SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue resolves them to 10/20 (basePoints+1), one point above the tooltip's 9%/19%.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Base Sargeron Smite crit chance is unaffected
